subject: doc
title: DOC.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-3 (Creative Music Outside of America — Britain, Germany, Holland — Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that 'Europe has always viewed the composite continuity of black creativity as a signal related to the progressional greater dynamics of black culture and world change' — Europe remembering Africa and the transformation that put her in power, in contrast to America's amnesia. (C)DOC (the concept of documentation) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what documentation produces when crossed with progressional-continuance in the European reception of black creativity. A vertical from the main line runs down to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which carries IST-F-ACT (isolated focus activism) and a long line up to POL-DY (political dynamics) on the upper-right. From POL-DY come INFO-COMP (information compression), which carries (R)OBS (the reality of observation) and (R)INT (the reality of intention), with LK-IMP (linkage implications) hanging from (R)INT; and a vertical down to (DT)OP-SPD (option spread, with the (dt) prefix marking it as 'determines the ___ of its ___'), which carries P-FC (particular focus) and a dashed line to INDIV-DY (individual dynamics).
